## Reusable rules

1. **Centralize shared linter policy in a repository-owned package** The review suggested replacing file-based ruleset wrappers with a workspace package; the response says the resolution centralizes the plane and client rulesets while preserving their upstream rules. *Scope:* Repository-wide TypeSpec linter ruleset packaging and configuration *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46750#discussion_r4127929569, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46750#discussion_r4253350513, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/f81bb831063f31ffa2dc7b19218acb9bbcf68bcf/eng/typespec-rulesets/index.ts

2. **Document repository-wide rule enablement** The later reviewer guidance says the README should explain how to enable a rule for everyone, rather than inviting service teams to select rules. Although an earlier response describes project-level opt-in guidance and a corresponding test, that does not resolve the later objection; keep this rule scoped to the requested documentation policy. *Scope:* TypeSpec linter rule-enablement guidance for service teams and repository maintainers *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46750#discussion_r4258147456, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46750#discussion_r4253351332, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/f81bb831063f31ffa2dc7b19218acb9bbcf68bcf/eng/typespec-rulesets/README.md

3. **Keep templates and emitter guidance aligned** The review requested an accompanying template update; the response says both canonical Widget templates and related guidance were updated, including the client-sdk ruleset when client emitter options are configured. *Scope:* TypeSpec emitter instructions, add-language prompt, and canonical project templates *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46750#discussion_r4127896557, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46750#discussion_r4253350975, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/f81bb831063f31ffa2dc7b19218acb9bbcf68bcf/.github/instructions/language-emitter.instructions.md, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/f81bb831063f31ffa2dc7b19218acb9bbcf68bcf/.github/prompts/tspconfig_add_missing_languages.prompt.md
